question: Does a lagged within-SOXX surprise in total Cboe option contract count add next-five-session realized-variance information beyond lagged SOXX price, realized variance and share volume?
distinctness: Total Cboe option participation intensity, not OCC put-share direction or implied-volatility skew; no reuse of their failed predictor sign or selection.

provider.price_plane: Use the existing SOXX Qlib provider and verify manifest and field hashes before any market outcome read; do not substitute another adjusted or raw price plane.

source_clock: At signal date s 09:46 New York, use Cboe total for s-1 only after its observed midnight publication window and Qlib close/volume through s-1. Earliest position opportunity s+1 open. Historical original publication vintages remain unproven, so all historical scores are diagnostic regardless of performance.

feature_formula.total_Cboe_contracts: Sum four Cboe exchange total-contract rows for SOXX on each Qlib trading date; exact calendar join with no missing-date compaction.
feature_formula.total_activity_surprise: log1p(total contracts(s-1)) minus median(log1p(total contracts(s-23..s-2))) over exactly 22 previous Qlib sessions.
baseline: SOXX close five-session return ending s-1
SOXX daily close-return realized standard deviation over five complete sessions ending s-1
same standard deviation over 22 complete sessions ending s-1

label.primary: For signal s, r_j=open[s+j+2]/open[s+j+1]-1, j=0..4; y=log(1e-8+sum(r_j^2)). Require all six opens finite and positive; no close-to-open leakage.
label.maturity: Open of s+6 plus one minute proxy; no label used before maturity.
label.economic_boundary: Future realized-variance information only; no account, tail-risk, fee-net or drawdown conclusion from this label.

model.baseline_and_candidate: Two fixed Ridge(alpha=1.0) fits; StandardScaler fit on train only; no sample weights or hyperparameter selection.

information_gate.paired_metric: Squared-error improvement = baseline (y-pred)^2 minus candidate (y-pred)^2 on identical held Qlib dates.

pre_execution_stops: Do not execute before frozen third same-date Cboe vintage at or after 2026-10-22 12:45 UTC and source identity readback.
Stop before fit if third observation changes prior date values or exact source/provider hashes differ; record observed revision rather than infer PIT.
Stop before fit if any train or held source date/label is missing, immature or misaligned; do not compact dates or select survivors.
No threshold, sign, horizon, alpha, window, baseline or missingness adjustment from held outcomes.
No account or promotion from reused market data or unqualified historical first-public timing.
goal_boundary: This screen can reject the mechanism. Even a pass only warrants separate bounded economic design plus qualified independent forward evidence under v2 SOXX 0/2/5bp cost, drawdown, CVaR, annual, rolling and bootstrap gates.
